lee.label: Netta Lee · фиксированный пример
lee.source:
board = [obs['c' + str(index)] for index in range(16)]
actions = ['up', 'right', 'down', 'left']
maximum = max(board)
position = board.index(maximum)
preferred = 'left' if position % 4 < 2 else 'right'
if position // 4 >= 1:
    preferred = 'down'
for direction in [preferred] + actions:
    if obs['valid_' + direction]:
        action = direction
        break
